verses.text: Xerxes (Ahashwerosh;ukpite’ ukpa) hun sung ahi hi. Hih pen India gam panin Ethiopia ciang dong a uk Xerxes hi a, gamneu 127 a uk hi.
Susa khuapi kumpi-inn-a ama kumpigam tokhom tungah kumpi Xerxes a tut ciangin,

Ama uk zawh a kum thumna kumin, amah in ama uliante leh mi liante khempeuh ahi: Media leh Persia mi vangliante aa ding, pawi khat a bawlsak a, tua lai-ah galkap uliante, mi liante leh gamneu ukpite a om uh hi.
Amah in ama kumpigam hauhna lianpite leh ama thupit mahmahna teng ni 180 sung tak a lakkhia hi.
Tu-in hih nite a bei khit ciangin, kumpipa in Susa khuapi kumpi-inn-a om milian, mineu, mi khempeuh aa dingin kumpi inn gei-a huan tual ah pawi tawpna ni sagih sung a bawlsak lai hi.

Tua huan pen suangmai khuampite tunga ngun kual tungah puan kang leh a dupsan nate kivawhin, a kikhai puandum leh puankangte tawh a kizem hi. Tua lai-ah suangmanpha a kang, a eng milhmelh, leh suangmai a kang leh a vomte tawh hoih takin a kizem suangphah tungah kham leh ngun lupnate a om hi.
A kibatpih khat beek zong a omlo kham haite tawh zu kihawm a, kumpipa cingh mahmahin, kumpi leenggahzu a kicing mahmah hi.
Kumpipa in ama innsung nasemte tungah a thupiakna tawh kizui-in zute pen tua cih hamtang ding cih a om kei hi. Mi khat ciat in amau duh peuhpeuh a dawn uh hi.
Kumpinu Vashti in zong kumpipa Xerxes’ kumpi-inn-a numeite aa dingin pawi khat a bawlsak hi.
A ni sagih ni-in leenggahzu hangin kumpipa a lungnop ciangin Kumpi Xerxes innsung mang cilgehte ahi Mehuman, Bizthan, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar leh Carcas-te thupia-in,
kumpinu a melhoih ahih manin mipite leh uliante tungah ama hoihna a lah theih nadingin kumpipa omna ah kumpigam kumpi-lukhu khusa-in kumpinu Vashti hong pai nadingin a sawl hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpinu Vashti in innsungmang cilgehte’ thupuak kumpipa thupiak ahih hangin a pai nuam kei hi. Hih thu hangin kumpipa lungso-in a heh mahmah hi.
Kumpipa in thukham a thei mi kivate thu a kuppih pah hi. (Thukham leh thutannate ah a siam mite a kuppih ding pen kumpipa aa dingin ngeina khat hi a,
ama kinaipihpen thudotpite in: Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, leh Memucan, kumpipa tawh a kiho thei, kumpigam sunga a za lianpente ahi Persia leh Media ulian sagihte ahi hi.)
Amah in, “Kumpinu Vashti in innsung mang cilgehte tungtawna kumpi Xerxes thupiakna mang lo ahih nungsang, thukham tawh kizui-in amah bang cih thei ding i hi hiam,” ci-in a dong hi.

Tua ciangin Memucan in kumpipa leh mi liante omin dawng a, “Kumpinu Vashti pen kumpipa tung bek a khial hi lo a, uliante khempeuh leh kumpi Xerxes ukna gam sunga mi khempeuh tungah zong a khial ahi hi.

Kumpinu’ gamtatna pen numei khempeuh in za ding uh a, amau mit ah a pasalte uh simmawh ding uh a, amaute in, ‘Kumpipa Xerxes in ama mai-ah a pai nadingin kumpinu Vashti thu a piak hangin amah pai lo hi,’ ci ding uh hi.

Tuni mahmah in Persia leh Media mi liante laka numeite in kumpinu’ gamtatna thu za ding uh a, kumpipa’ mi liante tungah tua mah bangin gamta ding uh hi. Kisimmawhna leh kizahtak lohna bei ngei lo ding hi.

Kumpipa na lungkim leh, kumpi thupiakna khat puak inla, Kumpipa Xerxes mai-ah Vashti a kipaipihkik ngei nawn loh nadingin a kilaih thei lo, kikhel ngei nawn lo ding Persia mite leh Media mite thukhamte sungah gelhsak in. Tua ciangin amah sangin a kilawmzaw numei khat ama gambup kumpinu hihna za luahsak in.
Tua bangin kumpipa’ thupiakna thu ama kumpigam lianpi sung khempeuh ah a kizak ciangin, numei khempeuh in a neu a lian amau pasal ciat zahtak ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Hih ngaihsutna in kumpipa lungkimsak a, kumpipa in Memucan’ kuppihna bangin a hih hi.

Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa gam sung khempeuh ah laikhakte khakin, pasal pen ama innkuan sungah lutang hi ding hi, ci-in amau gam ciat ah amau lai ciat tawh khakin leh amau pau ciat tawh mi khempeuh tungah a tangkosak hi.
Hih thu teng khit, Kumpipa Xerxes a hehna a daih ciangin, amah in Vashti phawkin, ama tungah dantatna a tuahsak nadinga tuanu gamtatnate a ngaihsun hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa’ nasemte in a ma kiangah, “Kumpipa aa dingin a melhoih khangno nungak laite zongsak in.

Kumpipa aw, Susa khuapi kumpi-inn-a numei-inn sungah amaute in a melhoih khangno nungak laite khempeuh a khawm dingin nangma kumpigam sung gamneute khempeuh-a uliante seh in. Kumpipa innsung mang numeite a uk Hegai ukna nuai-ah amaute om henla, numeite tungah melhoih nading kizepnate kipia tahen.
Tua ciangin kumpipa a lungkimsak numeinonu pen Vashti mun ah kumpinu hisak in,” a ci uh hi. Hih ngaihsutna in kumpipa lungkimsak a, amah in tua bangin a hih hi.
Kumpi khua Susa khuapi sungah Yahdah mi khat omin, ama min Mordecai hi a, amah pen Benyamin mi Kish’ tapa Shimei’ tapa Yair’ tapa ahi hi.
Amah pen Babylon kumpipa Nebuchadnezzar in Yerusalem pana salin a kaihsa ahi hi. Amah pen Yahdah kumpi Yahyakin tawh sala kikaite laka kihel ahi hi.

Mordecai in ama sanggamte’ tanu Hadassah khat a kem hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tuanu in pa ahi a, nu ahi zongin a nei nawn kei hi. Numeinonu pen a melhoih a, a thacingin a ngaihbaang hi. A nu leh a pa a sih ciangin, Mordecai in ama tanu mahmah bangin a kem hi.

Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa’ tangkona leh thukip a kizaksak ciang, kumpi khua Susa ah numei tampi a kikhawmin Hegai donna nuai ah om a, kumpi-inn ah Hadassah zong kila-in, numei uk Hegai tungah ki-ap hi.

Tu-in numeinonu in tuapa lungkimsak a, tua ciangin amah in tuanu a angvan hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in melhoih nading kizepnate sikin leh nisimin an a hamphat hi. Tua ciangin kumpi-inn panin tuanu aa dingin a kiteel nasem numei sagih zong kipia a, amah in numeite omna inn a hoihpen mun ah tuanu leh a nasepte a koih hi.
Mordecai in a gen lohna dingin khamna thupia ahih manin Hadassah in ama nam leh phung genkhia nai lo hi.
Hadassah bangci om a, ama tungah bang piang hiam cih a theih nadingin nisimin numeite’ omna huang mai-ah Mordecai pai den hi.

Tu-in numei khat ciat pen ama hoihna ding kizep hun kha sawm le kha nih a cin khit ciangin Kumpi Xerxes kiangah ama hun a tun cianga kipaipih ding ahi hi. Hih pen numeite aa dingin hoihna ding kizepna a kisehsa ahi hi: myrrh sathau tawh kha guk sung kizutin, paknamtuite leh kizepna tuamtuamte tawh kha guk sung kipuah hi.
Ama hoih nading kizepna hun a cin khit ciangin, kumpipa kiangah numeino khat ciat a pai kim uh hi. Tuanu in numeite’ inn nusia-in kumpipa tenna mun ah a pai ciangin, ama ken nop peuhpeuh a kipia hi.

Nitakin tuanu lutin, a zingsang ciangin kumpipa’ zineute a uk kumpipa’ innsung mang cilgehpa Shaashagaz donna numeite’ inn a mun dang khat ah a ciahkik hi. Kumpipa in tuanu a deih kei leh kumpipa kiangah cik mahin a paikik ngei nawn lo ding hi a, amah in a minminin sam hi.

Tu-in Mordecai’ (ama tanu mah banga a khansuahpa) sanggampa Abihail’ tanu Hadassah, kumpipa kiangah a pai ding hun hong hi ta a, numeite a uk kumpipa’ innsung mang Hegai ama tawi dinga a gente lobuang amah in bangmah dang a ngen kei hi. Hadassah a mu peuhpeuh in a ithuai a sa uh hi.
Tua hi a, ama uk zawh a kum sagihna kum, a kha sawmna ahi Tebeth kha sungin, ama kumpi-inn, Kumpi Xerxes kiangah Hadassah kipaipih hi.

Kumpipa in a zi dangte khempeuh sangin Hadassah ngaizaw a, ama angvanna ngahin nungak lai dangte khempeuh sangin deihzaw hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in tuanu lutung ah kumpi lukhu khusak a, Vashti mun ah ama kumpinu dingin a bawl hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in Hadassah pahtawina-in a uliante leh mi liante khempeuh aa dingin kitenna pawi lianpi khat a tangko hi. Amah in ama ukna gam khempeuh ah tuani ni thupi-in tangko a, kumpipa citna tawh letsongte tampi tak a hawmkhia hi.
Tua nungakte a kikhop hun sungin kumpipa’ kongpi a sunglam ah Mordecai a tu hi;
Tua hi a, Hadassah in Mordecai hilhsa bang teekteekin ama nam leh ama biakna thu a pulaak nai kei hi; Hadassah in amah a kikhansuah lai-a a hih ngei mah bangin Mordecai’ thu hilhnate a mang hi.
Tua hun lai-in kumpipa kongpi sunglam ah Mordecai a tut ciangin, kongkhak cing kumpipa’ innsung mang nih ahi Bigthan leh Teresh, kumpipa tungah hehin, Kumpi Xerxes thah dingin a sawmsim uh hi.
Ahih hangin Mordecai in sawmsimna thu mukhia-in Kumpinu Hadassah a zasak hi. Tua ciangin Hadassah in Mordecai’ min tawh kumpipa kiangah a gen hi.
Hih thu ah kantelna a kineih ciangin, sawmsimna a taktak ahih lam kithei a, gui awkna khuamte tungah a kikhai hi. Hih thu pen khang tangthu laibu sungah kumpipa omin kiciamteh hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin Kumpi Xerxes in Agag mi Hammedatha’ tapa Haman lamto-in, ama zum sungah za pia-in, mi liante lakah a uk lianpenin a bawl hi.

Kumpipa kongpi-a kumpi uliante khempeuh kunsukin Haman tungah zahtakna a pia uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua pen kumpipa in hih dingin a thupiaksa ahi hi. Ahih hangin Mordecai kunsukin zahtakna a pia kei hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kongpi sunglama om kumpipa’ uliante in Mordecai kiangah, “Bang hangin kumpipa’ thupiak mang lo na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.

A tawpna ah, ni khat khit ni khat amaute in ama kiangah gengen uh a, amah in a zui nuam tuan kei hi; amaute in Mordecai’ gamtatna hici bangin koih ding mah hiam, cih a theih nadingun Haman kiangah a zasak uh hi. (Tu-in Mordecai in amah Yahdah mi a hih lam amaute kiang genkhin hi.)
Amah zahtakna pia dingin Mordecai a kun loh lam Haman in a muh ciangin, Haman heh tawpin a heh hi.

Ahi zongin amah in Mordecai bek a that nuam kei hi. Amaute in Mordecai’ mipihte a om lam ama kiangah gen khin ahih manin Haman in Xerxes’ kumpigam sung bup khempeuh ah Yahdah mi khempeuh, Mordecai leh amaute a suksiat theih nadingin lampi a zong hi.

Kumpi Xerxes uk zawh a kum sawm le nihna kum, a kha masa pen ahi Nisan kha-in, a ni leh a kha a teel dingin Haman mai-ah amaute in pur a lawn uh hi. A Kha Sawm le Nihna kha ahi Adar kha, a ni sawm le ni thum ni ah ailotna a tu hi.

A ni leh a kha lak ailotna a kilot khit ciangin, Haman in kumpipa mai-ah hih thu puakin, “Na kumpigam sunga gamneu khempeuh-a minamte lakah kizelin a kithehthang minam khat a om hi. Amau Thukhamte pen minam dangte khempeuh aa tawh kibang lo a, amaute in kumpipa’ thupiakte nangawn mang lo uh hi! Hih thu ah, amaute na khahkhong ding pen kumpipa aa dingin a hoih hilo hi.
Kumpipa na lungkim ahih leh, amaute a kisuksiat ding thu kiciamteh henla, hih thu a kisep nadingin kumpipa sumkholna ah ngun talent tul sawm ka pia pah ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in ama khut panin a seal tupna zungbuh suahkhia-in, Yahdah mite’ gal Agag mi Hammedatha’ tapa Haman tungah a pia hi.
Kumpipa in Haman kiangah, “Na sum nangmah in kem inla, mite nang aa hi, na lungkim bangin hih in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin a Kha Masa a ni sawm le ni thum ni-in kumpipa’ lai-atte kisam a, Haman genkhiat bang teekteekin thupiakna kigelhin, kumpipa’ gam uksawnte tung; gamkhen lian-a gam-ukte, gamkhen neu leh khuapite a uk gam-ukte tung, leh mipi khempeuh makaite tungah Kumpi Xerxes min tawh khakin, kumpi seal tupna zungbuh tawh seal a tum hi. (Lai-atte in gam khempeuh ah amau lai ciat, mi khempeuh kampau ciat tawh hih thute a gelh uh hi.)

Pasal leh pasalno, numei leh a naupang a vekpi-in Yahdah mi khempeuh a Kha Sawm le Nihna kha Adar kha, a ni sawm le thum ni, ni khat thu-in a susia ding, a that ding, leh a beisiangsak ding leh amau neihsate a sutmang dingin kumpipa ukna gam sung khempeuh ah a manlang kamtaite tungtawnin laikhakte a paisak hi.
Tua ni-in a baihsa-in a om theih nadingin gam khempeuh ah thukham khat bangin a suahkhia dingin minamte khempeuh theih dingin dal khat ciat a kipuak hi.

Kumpipa’ thupiakna tawh manlang takin pai uh a, kumpi khua Susa ah hih thupiak a kitangko hi. Tua khit ciangin kumpipa leh Haman zu dawn dingin tukhawm uh a, ahih hangin Susa khuapi sung a buai mahmah hi.
Mordecai in hih thupiang khempeuh a phawk a theihkhak ciangin, Mordecai in a puante balkek a, ippi puan silhin vut kibuak a, nakpi takin kap ziahziah kawmin khuapi sungah a paikawikawi hi.
Kumpi kongpi ciang dong amah pai hi; ahih hangin kumpi kongpi ah ippi puan silhin kuamah lut theihna thu omlo hi.
Kumpipa thupiak a kitangkona gam sung khempeuh, Yahdah mite lakah antanna, kahna, thuumna tawh nakpi-in tauna om a, ippi puan silhin vut a kibuak uh hi.

Hadassah’ nasem numeite leh a innsung mangte pai-in ama kiangah tua thu a gen ciangin kumpinu lungkham mahmah hi. Mordecai in a ippi puan a suahkhiat nadingin amah in Mordecai silh dingin puan khak a, ahih hangin amah in a sang nuam kei hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in amah a don dingin a seh kumpi-inn sunga innsung mang khat ahi Hathach pen Hadassah in samin, bang in Mordecai buaisakin bang hang hiam, cih a kan dingin Mordecai kiangah a pai nadingin thu a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpi kongpi mai, khuapi tual awng sunga om Mordecai kiangah Hathach a pai hi.
Tua ciangin Mordecai in ama kiangah a piang thu khempeuh leh Yahdah mite suksiat nadingin kumpi sumkholna ah piak dingin Haman ciamna sum phazah zong a gen hi.

Amah in Hadassah kiangah puakin hoih takin a gen theih nading leh amaute tangin kumpipa kiangah pai-in a thuumsak zia ding a hilh theih nading leh ama mite aa dingin kumpipa mai-ah a thuum theih nadingin Susa khuapi pana tangkona bangin amaute a kisuksiat nading thupiakna lai a kigelh sawn zong ama kiangah pia hi.
Hathach ciahkikin, Mordecai in a gensa thu khempeuh Hadassah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Hadassah in Mordecai aa dingin Hatthach kiangah thu khat pia a,

“Sapna om masa lo pi-in kumpipa omna huang sungnung ah numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin a pai peuhmah dantatna khat bek om a; tua in thah ding ahi hi, cih thu kumpipa’ uliante khempeuh leh kumpipa gamte-a mite nangawn in a theikim uh hi. Tua dantatna ah a tuamdeuh thu khat bek om a, tua pen kumpipa in ama lamah kham ciangkhut a zan khiat leh bek amah nungta thei ding hi. Tua hi a, kumpipa omna ah a pai dingin kei hong kisap loh ni sawmthum bang pha ta hi,” a ci hi.
Hadassah kiang pana hih thu amaute in Mordecai kiangah a gensawn uh hi.
Mordecai in Hadassah kiangah, “Kumpi-inn sungah na omna hangin Yahdah mi khempeuh lakah nang bek a suakta dingin kingaihsun kei in.

Bang hang hiam cihleh hih hun ah bangmah hih lo-a na daihcip leh, mun dang khat panin suahtakna leh hotkhiatna hong piang ding hi; ahih hangin nang leh na pa’ innkuan na siamang ding uh hi. Hih bang hun cianga mah dingin kumpi tokhom ah a tung na hih na meel zong kua in thei ahi hiam?” ci-in hih dawnna a khakkik hi.
Tua ciangin Hadassah in Mordecai kiangah hih thukkikna a khak hi:

“Pai inla tu-in Susa ah Yahdah mi khempeuh kaikhawmin, kei aa dingin an na tang un. Ni thum sung zan ahi a, sunin ahi zongin bangmah ne loin bangmah na dawn kei un. Kei leh ka nasemte in zong no mah bangin ka tang ding hi. Hih bangin hih hun sung mahin thukham tawh kituak lopi mahin kumpipa kiangah ka va pai ding hi. Hong kithah leh a si ka hi lel ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mordecai pai-in, Hadassah in ama tunga a hilhsa bangin a semkhia hi.

A ni thumni-in Hadassah in ama kumpi puantualpite silhin, kumpi innsungpi mai kumpi inntual sungnung ah amah a ding hi. Kumpi tokhom inndei sung ama tokhom tungah kumpipa tu-in, huang lutna lam a maingat hi.

Kumpipa in huang ah Kumpinu Hadassah a ding a muh ciangin, amah a muh ding a lungkim a, kumpipa in a khut sunga kham ciangkhut tuanu lamah a van hi. Tua ciangin Hadassah in amah nehin, ciangkhut dawn a lawng hi.
Kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Bang deihna hi hiam, Kumpinu Hadassah aw? Bang hong ngen nuam na hi hiam? Ka kumpigam phal lang nangawn nong nget leh zong, nang tungah hong kipia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Hadassah in, “Kumpipa na lungkim ahih leh, kumpipa aa dingin ka kiginsa pahtawina ankuang thupi ah tuni-in Haman tawh hong siim khawm un,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Hadassah ngetna bangin a kihih theih nadingin manlang takin Haman sam un,” ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin Hadassah kiginsa pahtawina ankuang thupi ah kumpipa leh Haman a nih tuakun a pai uh hi.

Amaute in leenggahzu a dawn kawmkawmin, kumpipa in Hadassah kiangah, “Nong nget nop bang ahi hiam? Nang tungah hong kipia ding hi! Na deihna lianpi bang ahi hiam? Kumpigam phal lang nangawn ahih leh zong, hong kipia ding hi!” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hadassah in, “Hih in kong ngetna leh ka deih lianpi ahi hi.

Kumpipa mit ah maipha ka muh a, ka deihna lianpi nong piak ding leh kong ngetna na tangtunsak ding kumpipa na lungkim ahih leh, kumpipa leh Haman aa dingin ka kiginsa pahtawina ankuang thupi ah hong pai un. Zingciangin kong ngetna leh ka deihna lianpi kong gen ding hi,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tuni-in lungdam kipaak takin Haman a paikhia hi; ahih hangin kumpi kongpi ah Haman a pai ciangin dingto loin ama mai-ah kitakna lim zong a lah lohna a muh ciangin, Mordecai tungah a heh mahmah hi.
Tua hi na pi-in Haman ki-ip tentanin inn ah a ciah hi; tua lai ah amah in a lawmte leh ama zi Zeresh a sam hi.

Tua ciangin Haman in ama hauhna, a tate phazah, kumpipa in amah a lapsang zia khempeuh, leh kumpigam sungah adang uliante khempeuh leh mi liante khempeuh sangin a lianzaw-in a koihna thu teng amaute tungah genin a lakkhia hi.
Haman in amaute tungah, “Tuate khempeuh banah, Kumpinu Hadassah in kumpipa aa dingin a bawl pahtawina ankuang thupi ah kei bek hong sam a, zingciangin amah in kumpipa tawh kei hong sam lai hi.
Ahih hangin kumpi kongpi ah a tu Yahdah mi Mordecai ka muh laiteng hihte khempeuh in lungkimna hong pia zo kei hi,” a cih beh lai hi.

Tua ciangin ama zi Zeresh leh a lawmte khempeuh in ama kiangah ngaihsutna pia-in, “Gui awkna khuampite tong sawmnga kisangsak hen. Tua ciang, zingciang zingsangin kumpipa kiangah gen inla, tua tungah Mordecai a kikhai nadingin ngen in. Tua khit ciangin pahtawina ankuang thupi ah kumpipa tawh nuamtakin na om thei ding hi,” a ci uh hi. Hih ngaihsutna in Haman lungkim sak hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in gui awkna khuampite a lam hi.
Tua zanin kumpipa a ihmu thei kei hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in kumpipa’ uk hun sunga khang tangthu laibu ciaptehna a kilak nadingin thu pia a, amaute in kumpipa mai-ah a sim uh hi.
Kongcingte in Kumpi Xerxes thah dingin a sawmsim Bigthan leh Teresh thute Mordecai in a puak ahihna thu tua lai-a ciaptehna sungah kimu hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Hih thu hangin Mordecai tungah bang pahtawina leh bang lungdamlahna kipia ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Ama nasem kumpipa’ uliante in, “Ama aa dingin bangmah kihihsak ngei nai lo hi,” ci-in a dawng uh hi.

Kumpipa in, “Huang sungah kua om ahi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. (Tu-in Haman in a bawlsa gui awkna khuamte tungah kumpipa in Mordecai a khailup nading a ngen dingin kumpipa tenna mun-a huang puanung ah Haman a lutkhit deuh ahi hi.)
Kumpipa nasemte in ama kiangah, “Huang sungah Haman dingin, tua lai-ah hong ngak hi,” a ci uh hi. Kumpipa in, “Hong lutsak un,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Haman lut a, kumpipa in ama kiangah, “Kumpipa pahtawi nop mipa aa dingin bang kihihsak leh hoihsa na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Haman in a lungsim sungah, “Kumpipa in kei sangin a pahtawi nopzawk kua om ding ahi hiam?” ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah, “Kumpipa pahtawi nop mipa aa dingin:
“Kumpipa silh kumpi puantualpi silhsak inla, kumpipa tuanna sakol tungah tuangin, kumpipa lutunga om den kumpigam-a kumpi-lukhu khusak in.

Tua ciangin kumpipa’ mi lianpen khat tungah hih puante leh sakolte kipia henla, kumpipa pahtawi nop mipa tungah tuate tawh kizem hen. Tua ciangin mi lianpenpa in amah sakol tungah tuangsakin khuapi tual awng sung khempeuh ah makaih-in ama mai-ah, ‘Hih in kumpipa pahtawi nop mipa a kibawlzia ahi hi,’ ci-in tangkosak in,” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, “Tu mahmahin paipah in! Nong ngaihsut piaksa bang teekteekin, puansilhte leh sakol la inla, kumpi kongpi ah a tu Yahdah mi Mordecai tungah silhsak in. Na gensa khempeuh khat beek zong kipelhsak kei in,” a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Haman in puansilh leh sakol la-in Mordecai zem a, sakol tungah amah tuangsakin khuapi tual awng sung khempeuh ah makaih a, ama mai-ah, “Hih in kumpipa pahtawi nop mipa a kibawlzia ahi hi,” ci-in a tangko hi.
Hih khit ciangin kumpi kongpi ah Mordecai ciahkik hi; ahih hangin Haman in khasiatna tawh a lu khuhin, lungkia takin inn ah a ciah vingveng hi.

Haman in a zi leh a lawmte kiang a piang thu khempeuh a gen hi. Tua ciangin ama thudotte leh a zi in ama kiangah, “Ama mai-ah puk ding na kipatna mipa Mordecai pen Yahdah mi khat ahih nungsangin, ama langah na gualzo kei ding hi; ama mai-ah na puk taktak ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Amaute a kiho laitak mahin kumpipa’ innsung mangte hong tungin, Hadassah kiginsa pahtawina ankuang thupi ah Haman a la dingin hong kinawh mahmah uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hadassah tawh nitak ankuang um khawm dingin kumpipa leh Haman a pai uh hi.

A ni nihna ni-in amaute in leenggahzu a dawn laitak mahin, kumpipa in Hadassah kiangah, “Na deih lianpi bang ahi hiam, Kumpinu Hadassah aw? Nang tungah hong kipia ding hi! Nong nget nop bang ahi hiam? Ka kumpigam phal lang nangawn nong nget leh zong, hong kipia ding hi,” a ci leuleu hi.

Tua ciangin Kumpinu Hadassah in, “Kumpipa aw, nangma mit ah maipha ka muh a, kumpipa na lungkim ahih leh, kong nget nop thu pen kei hong kinuntaksak ding hi a, ka deih lianpi pen ka mipihte nuntakna kipia nading ahi hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh kei leh ka mitepen suksiat ding, sihna ding leh beisiangsak dingin hong kizuakkhin hi. Sila numei leh sila pasalte bangin kote hong kizuak hileh, themcik beek zong ka pau kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cihleh tua bang thu lel tawh kumpipa nawngkaisak taak ka sa kei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hadassah kiangah kumpipa awngin, “Kua ahi hiam? Tua bang thu a hih ngam mipa koi ah om ahi hiam?” a ci hi.
Hadassah in amah dawngin, “Ka galpa leh ka langpa, hih migilo Haman ahi hi!” a ci hi. Tua ciangin Haman kumpipa leh kumpinu mai-ah Haman nakpi takin a lau hi.

Hehna tawh kumpipa a leenggahzu phual panin dingkhia-in kumpi huan sungah a pai hi; ahih hangin Haman om lai-in a nuntak nadingin Hadassah kiangah a thuum hi; bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa in ama dantatna ding a khensatsa a hih lam sehkhol khin hi.

Kumpi huan panin ankuang umna innpi ah kumpipa hong paikik ciangin amah in Hadassah a nunglama a kingapna tutphah tungah Haman a puksukna a mu hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Hih inn sungah ka omlai nangawnin hih mipa in kumpinu bawlsiat sawm lai ahi hiam? Kumpipa in hih thute a genkhiat phetin Haman mai a tuncip pah uh hi.

Tua ciang innsung mangte khat ahi Harbonah in kumpipa kiangah, “En in! Gui-awhna khuam tong sawmnga a sang khat Haman’ inn gei-ah om hi. Amah in kumpipa nuntakna hong hon Mordecai kikhai nadingin a lam ahi hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, “Tua tungah amah khai un!” ci-in thu a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mordecai aa dingin a lam gui-awhna khuamte tungah amaute in Haman khailum uh a, tua ciangin kumpipa hehna a dai hi.
Tuani mahin Kumpi Xerxes in Yahdah mite gal Haman neihsa buppi Hadassah a pia hi. Kumpipa omna sungah Mordecai pai hi; bang hang hiam cihleh Hadassah in amau kinaina thu kumpipa kiangah a gen hi.
Kumpipa in Haman kiang pana a lakkhiatsa ama seal tupna zungbuh suahkhia-in, Mordecai kiangah a pia hi. Tua ciangin Hadassah in Haman’ neihsa khempeuh a uk dingin Mordecai a koih hi.
Hadassah khitui namtui tawh kumpipa’ khephung ah pukin a va thuum leuleu hi. Agag mi Haman in Yahdah mite langpanin a sawmsimnate ahi, ama gitloh sawmnate a beisak nadingin a thuum hi.
Kumpipa in ama lamah kham ciangkhut zan hi; tua ahih ciangin Hadassah dingto-in kumpipa omna ah ding a,

“Kumpipa na lungkim ahih a, ama mit ah maipha mu-in, kumpipa muhna ah hih thu a man ahih a, kei tungah amah a lungkim ahih leh, kumpipa gam sung khempeuh-a Yahdah mite beisiangsak ding sawmna-in Agag mi Hamedatha’ tapa Haman geelsa laite a khuplet dingin thupiakna khat gelhsak in.
Ka mipihte tungah hih siatna a tunna ka muh ciangin bangci bangin thuakzo ding ka hi hiam? Ka tanaute kisuksiatna ka muh ciangin bangci bangin thuakzo ding ka hi hiam?

Tua ciangin Kumpi Xerxes in Kumpinu Hadassah leh Yahdah mi Mordecai kiangah, “Haman in Yahdah mite tungah a khut nga kha ding ahih manin gui-awkna khuamte tungah amah kikhailum zo a, Haman’ neihsate, Hadassah tungah ka piakhin hi.

Ahih hangin nang mahmah in Yahdah mi khempeuh tangin kumpipa’ min tawh na lungkim bangin adang thukip khat gelh inla, kumpipa seal tupna zungbuh tawh seal tum in,” a ci hi. (Bang hang hiam cihleh kumpipa’ min tawh a kigelhin, kumpipa’ seal tupna zungbuh tawh a seal a kitum lai pen kidawkkik thei nawn kei hi.)

Tua ahih ciangin a Kha Thumna Kha Sivan kha, a ni sawmthum le thumna ni, tua hun lai-in kumpipa’ lai-atte kisam hi. Amaute in Yahdah mite tangin Mordecai’ thupiak kammalte khempeuh gelhin, gamkhen ukte, gam-ukte, India panin Ethiopia ciang dong a vekpi-in gam 127 a uk gam sung uliante tungah a khak hi. Hih thupiakna pen amau gam lai ciat, amau minam pau ciat tawh kigelh a, Yahdah mite aa dingin zong amau lai amau pau tawh a kigelh hi.
Amah in Kumpi Xerxes’ min tawh gelhin, kumpipa’ seal tupna zungbuh tawh tua thupiakna seal tumin, a taihat kumpi-sakolte tungah laitaite kituangsakin tua thupiakna a kihawmsak hi.

Kumpipa’ thupiakna pen amau nuntakna a kidal nading deihna-in khuapi khempeuh ah Yahdah mite a kikaihkhop theih ding phalna ahi hi. Minam khatpeuh lak pan galvan tawh kitawisa khatpeuh ahi a, amaute tungah hitaleh amau numei naupangte tungah hitaleh a galbawl nuam a ki-uksawn gam khatpeuh ahi zongin suksiat ding, thah ding, leh beisiangsak theih dingin amaute in phalna ngah uh a, amau neihsate zong a laksak theih nadingun phalna ngah uh hi.
A Kha Sawm le Kha nihna Adar kha, a ni sawm le ni thumna ni, ni khat sungin Kumpi Xerxes ukna gam khempeuh ah hih thute khempeuh a kihih dingin a beisa huna thupiaksa khat ahi hi.
Tua ni-in Yahdah mite in a galte uh a thukkik dingin a kiginkholh theih nadingin hih thu pen thukip khatin gam khempeuh ah a kigelhsawn tua lai kihawmkhia-in, mi khempeuh tungah kitangko hi.
Sakol taihatte tunga a tung laitaite in kumpipa thupiakna tawh nawhtatin, hih thukip a hawm dingin a taikhia uh hi. Tua hun laitak mahin kumpi khuapi Susa ah hih thukip a kitangko hi.

Mordecai in a dum leh a kang kumpi puante silhin kumpipa omna panin a paikhia hi. A lu tungah kham lukhum kizem lianpi khat khu-in, amah in puangsan saihadial puan hoih khat zong a silh hi; tua hi a, Susa khuapi ah lungdamna leh lungnopna om hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah mite in khuavak leh lungnopna, kipaakna leh pahtawina a ngah uh hi.

Tua banah kumpipa’ thupiakna leh thukip a kitangkona gam sung leh khuapi sung peuhpeuh ah Yahdah mite nuamin kipaak uh a, pawi bawlin a gualnop uh hi. Gam sung mi tampite, Yahdah mi hi ung, ci-in a kipulaak uh hi; bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in Yahdah mite a kihta uh hi.

A Kha Sawm le Nihna Adar kha, a ni sawm le ni thum ni, a beisa huna kiseh hunin kumpipa’ thupiakna leh thukip a kisepkhiat ding hun a tung hi. (Yahdah mite galte in amaute zogawp dingin a kilam-et ni-in, tuate khempeuh kilumlet a, Yahdah mite in amau a mudah mite a zogawp uh hi.)

Amau suksiat theih nading a zong mite a that dingin Kumpi Xerxes’ gam sung khempeuh-a amau khuapite ah Yahdah mite a kikaikhawm uh hi. Mi khempeuh tungah amaute kihtakhuaina tung khin ahih manin amaute langah pangzo khat beek a om kei hi.
Tua banah amaute in Mordecai kihta uh ahih manin gamke uliante, gam lian ukte, gam-ukte leh kumpipa’ na a sem mi khempeuh in Yahdah mite a panpih uh hi.
Mordecai pen vanglianin kumpi-inn sungah thuneipi suak hi. Ama vangliat semsemna leh ama kitheih semsemna zui-in ama minthanna pen gam sung khempeuh ah a kizel hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahdah mite in a galte khempeuh uh zogawpin, namsau vikin amaute beisiangsak a, amau a muhdah mite tungah a ut bangbangun a hih uh hi.
Kumpi khuapi Susa sung mahmah ah zong Yahdah mite in mi 500 that uh hi.
Amaute in Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,
Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,
Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, leh Vahzatha-te zong that uh a,
amaute pen Yahdah mite gal, Hammedatha’ tapa Haman’ tapa sawmte ahi hi. Ahih hangin Yahdah mite in a neihsate uh a suksak kei uh hi.
Tua ni mahin kumpi khuapi Susa sungah a kithat mi phazah pen kumpipa tungah a kipuak hi.

Kumpipa in Kumpinu Hadassah kiangah, “Yahdah mite in kumpi khuapi Susa sung bekbek ah mi 500 that uh a, Haman’ tapa sawmte zong a that uh hi. Kumpipa’ gam a omlaite ah zong bangcih lai ding uh ahi hiam? Tu-in na deihna lianpi bang ahi hiam? Nang tungah hong kipia ding hi! Nong nget nop beh lai bang om ahi hiam? Nong nget bangin kihih ding hi!” a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Hadassah in, “Kumpipa na lungkim ahih leh, tuni-a a kihih mah bangin Susa khuapi sungah Yahdah mite in tuni-a thukip zingciangin zong hih theihna pia lai inla, gui-awkna khuamte tungah Haman’ tapate kikhaisak in,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in hih thu a kisep nadingin thupia a, Susa khuapi sungah hih thu a kitangko hi. Gui-awkna khuamte tungah a sisa Haman’ tapa sawmte a kikhai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Adar kha, a ni sawm le ni li ni-in Susa khuapi sunga Yahdah mite kikhawmkik-in, Susa khuapi sungah mi 300 a that beh uh hi; ahih hangin amaute in a neihsate uh a suksak kei uh hi.

Tua hun sungin, kumpipa gamte sunga Yahdah mi adangte zong kigawm khawmin a galte uh kiang panin a kihut theih nadingun a nang uh hi. Amaute in amau a mudah mi 75,000 that uh hi; ahih hangin amaute in a neihsate uh a suksak kei uh hi.
Gamkete sunga kidona pen Adar kha, a ni sawm le ni thum ni-in piang a, ahih hangin tua kha a ni sawm le ni li ni-in khawlin, tua ni pen pawi bawlna leh lungnopna ni a suaksak uh hi.

Ahih hangin a do dingin a ni sawm le ni thum ni leh tua kha a ni sawm le ni li ni-in zong Susa khuapi sunga Yahdah mite a kigawm uh hi; hih thu in tua kha a ni sawm le ni li ni-a thu hi a, amaute tawlnga-in pawi bawlna leh lungnopna ni-in a bawl uh hi.
(Hih hangin kulh nei lo khuaneute sunga teng Yahdah mite in Adar kha a ni sawm le ni li ni pen lungnopna leh pawi bawl ni, leh a zawng amau vengte kiangah an sehtante a kholh ni-in a zang uh hi.)
Tua ciangin Mordecai in hih thute ciamtehin, Kumpipa Xerxes ukna gam khempeuh-a om a nai a gamla-a Yahdah mi khempeuh kiangah laikhakte khak a,
Amaute lakah Adar kha a ni sawm le ni li ni leh a ni sawm le ni nga ni-in pawi a bawl lai nading uh hi a,

Yahdah mite in a galte uh kiang panin suahna nak a ngah ni, dahna panin nuamna ah, thuumna panin gualnopna ah a kihei kha sungin tua nite a phawk nadingun a khak ahi hi. Amah in hih nite pen pawi bawlna leh lungnopna ni-in a zat nading, khat le khat an kikholhin, mi zawngte tungah a piak ni-in a zat nadingun amaute tungah lai a gelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Yahdah mite in amau patsa ngeina zomin Mordecai in amaute aa dinga a gelh bangin sep ding a thukim uh hi;

bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah mi khempeuh galpa, Agag mi Hammedatha’ tapa Haman in amaute a beisiangsak theih nadingin Yahdah mite langah sawmsimin, amau kisiat nading leh suksiat theih nadingin Pur (ai lotna) a lawn khin hi.

Ahih hangin kumpipa mai-ah Kumpinu Hadassah a pai ciangin kumpipa in Yahdah mite langa Haman ngaihsut piak a sia sawmsimna pen ama lu tung a tunkik theih nading leh amah leh a tapate gui-awhna khuamte tungah a kikhai theih nadingin a kigelh thupiakna khat a pia hi.

Hih thu hangin hih nite pen Purim; Ailotnate, kici a, Pur kammal panin hong pai ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin hih laikhak sunga a kigelh thu khempeuh hang leh, amaute khempeuh muhkhak tuahkhaksa khempeuh hangin,

Amaute in kipelh ngei loin a zop suakna ding, amau lai sunga a kilak hih ni nihte leh a kigen nite ah a gualnop nadingun Yahdah mite thukim uh a, amaute, amau suanlekhakte leh amau a pawlpih khempeuh aa dingin ngeina khatin a bawl uh hi;

Hih nite a kiphawk theih nading leh a khangkhangin, a innkuankuanin, a gamgamin, a khuapi peuhpeuh uh ah a zuih theih nadingin a bawl uh ahi hi; tua ahih ciangin hih Purim nite pen Yahdah mite lak ah a kibawl ding khawl lo ding a, amau thute, amau suanlekhakte lakah kimang ngilh lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin Abihail’ tanu Kumpinu Hadassah, leh Yahdah mi Mordecai in Purim thu tawh kisai-in kipsakna dingin thuneihpenna tawh hih laikhak nihna a gelh uh hi.
Mordecai in Xerxes’ kumpigam sunga gam 127 ah kilemna leh khamuanna a om nadingin laikhakte khak a,

Yahdah mi Mordecai leh Kumpinu Hadassah in amaute aa dingin a thupiaksa bang teekteekin a kiseh nite ah hih Purim nite a kipsak nading leh, amau aa dingin a kipsaksa mah bangin amau suanlekhakte in amau antan hun leh tamlawhna hun ciangin a phawkna ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hadassah’ thupiakna in hih Purim ngeinate kipsak a, laibute sungah a kiciamteh hi.
Kumpi Xerxes in ama ukna leitung hitaleh tuipi-a tuikulhte tungah hitaleh siah a kai hi.
Tu-in ama vangliatna leh ama sepkhiatnate leh kumpipa in a laptoh Mordecai liatna khempeuh, Media leh Persia kumpite khang tangthu laibu sungah kigelh hilo ahi hiam?

Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahdah mi Mordecai pen Kumpipa Xerxes zom ah a lianpen hi a, ama sanggam mi honpite in amah a tawisang uh hi. Amah in a mipihte phattuam theihpen nadingin nasem a, ama lawm Yahdah mite hoih nadingin thu a gen hi.
